column1: # Note: Rates are fractions (0.05 = 5%). An empty cell is a figure the trust did not report that month.
# Note: ALL is shown only for months in which at least three trusts holding at least 80% of receivables reported.
# Columns: trust = the trust's ticker (ALL = every trust
column2: weighted by receivables); trust_name = the issuing entity; month = collection month
column4: US dollars; payment_rate = monthly principal payment rate; charge_off_rate = charge-off rate
column5: on the basis in charge_off_basis; charge_off_basis = net or gross; default_rate_gross = gross default rate; default_rate_net = net default rate; portfolio_yield = portfolio yield before charge-offs (gross)
column6: annualized; excess_spread = excess spread for the whole trust (its own figure
column8: annualized; dq_30plus = share of receivables 30+ days past due; dq_30_60 = 30-60 days past due; dq_61_90 = 61-90 days; dq_91_120 = 91-120 days; dq_120plus = 120+ days
